speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the specific nature of your gait and limb ataxia; do you experience intentional tremors or a sensory level in your legs? Additionally, could you detail your significant medical history, including any past infections, autoimmune conditions, or heavy metal exposures?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that description; the "drunk" appearance and right-sided clumsiness suggest a focal lesion in the cerebellum or brainstem. Have you noticed any slurred speech, double vision, or difficulty swallowing recently? Also, have you ever suffered from syphilis or Lyme disease, and do you currently have any sensory numbness or tingling in your feet?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast
